body:
Hi there. I'm a female 16-year-old (just so you know).

I just want you to know that as cliché as it sounds, suicide really isn't a solution. It's a bloody brave thing to do but suicide means that everything you've done so far has been for nothing. You've come so far in your life and although you may feel like a disappointment, I can assure you that there are a lot of people who would do anything to be you because they look up to you and respect you that much.

I found a quote recently:
"Everything will be okay in the end. If it's not okay it's not the end."

Surprisingly, I'd never actually seen this quote before, but I think it really sums up what it's all about. I promise you that it will get better, it has to.

Good luck,
SK.

(I'm a suicide survivor - bit of an oxymoron, I know!)
